reviewSamples.author: Photo of Jess Drapluk
reviewSamples.text: Fayemas Foods is hands-down the best food in Miami!! Everything they make tastes amazing especially the skewers, burritos, and BBQ. I'm getting hungry just thinking about Fayemas Foods while writing this review! thank you guys for the best foods in Miami!!!
